bo-t.label: Average batting positions used per regular GT batter, 2024–2026
bo-t.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
bo-t.filters: Batters with at least eight innings
bo-t.query: WITH appear AS (SELECT d.innings_id, d.batter_id pid, MIN(d.delivery_id) first FROM deliveries d GROUP BY d.innings_id, d.batter_id UNION ALL SELECT d.innings_id, d.non_striker_id pid, MIN(d.delivery_id) first FROM deliveries d GROUP BY d.innings_id, d.non_striker_id), firsts AS (SELECT innings_id, pid, MIN(first) first FROM appear GROUP BY innings_id, pid), pos AS (SELECT innings_id, pid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY innings_id ORDER BY first, pid) position FROM firsts) SELECT bt, AVG(np) avgPositions, COUNT(*) players FROM ( SELECT i.batting_team_id bt, pos.pid, COUNT(DISTINCT pos.position) np, COUNT(*) inns FROM pos JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = pos.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = i.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026 GROUP BY i.batting_team_id, pos.pid HAVING inns >= 8) GROUP BY bt

bo-most.label: GT's most-moved batter, 2024–2026
bo-most.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
bo-most.query: WITH appear AS (SELECT d.innings_id, d.batter_id pid, MIN(d.delivery_id) first FROM deliveries d GROUP BY d.innings_id, d.batter_id UNION ALL SELECT d.innings_id, d.non_striker_id pid, MIN(d.delivery_id) first FROM deliveries d GROUP BY d.innings_id, d.non_striker_id), firsts AS (SELECT innings_id, pid, MIN(first) first FROM appear GROUP BY innings_id, pid), pos AS (SELECT innings_id, pid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY innings_id ORDER BY first, pid) position FROM firsts) SELECT pl.name, COUNT(*) inns, COUNT(DISTINCT pos.position) positions, MIN(pos.position) top, MAX(pos.position) low FROM pos JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = pos.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = i.match_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = pos.pid WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.batting_team_id IN (14) AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026 GROUP BY pos.pid HAVING inns >= 8 ORDER BY positions DESC, inns DESC
